title: Seeking that lands in Naam
subtitle: For the search that needs depth more than novelty
description: These readings guide spiritual hunger away from constant motion and into the wealth of Naam, patient listening, and saintly company.

heroSource.shortMeaning: True bankers trade in Naam; the search becomes wealthy when wandering ceases in sangat.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Let the search become obedience before it becomes another tour of ideas.

evidence.coreClaim: This journey turns seeking into a life that dwells with the Name.
evidence.turn: The search finds dignity when it trades novelty for Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: Choose one practice of listening and remain with it after curiosity wants to move on.
